name: Practiced Stonesman
body:
Not only can you catch stones with the rest of them, you’re talented at throwing them as well — with deadly accuracy.

Prerequisite(s) Jötunfolk, base attack bonus +3

Benefit(s) You gain the rock Throwing racial trait.

Normal Standard jötunfolk begin play with the intimidating prowess racial trait.
